description: `def run(&b)` reifies the passed block as an ordinary local `b` (a `pblock` param), which is then called with `b.call(5)` -- the same elimination form as a lambda's. This is the reified counterpart of yield-arith: the block arrives as a *value* with an arrow type, so `Param.block`'s type is exactly the type of the block literal at the call site.
